Tools.Place: Place particles (click; Shift snaps to the grid)
Tools.Mold: Mold particles: drag a particle's outline by hand (click one to pick it)
Tools.Emitter: Place emitters (click; right-click one to remove it)
Tools.Cast: Cast the current effect (click; uses the selected token and your targets)
Tools.Clear: Remove all particles, auras and emitters from this scene
Tools.Manager: Scene particles: manage every particle on this scene
Tools.Walls: Effect walls: walls of fire, chains, ice… along any path

PlayersCanCast.Name: Players can cast effects
PlayersCanCast.Hint: Let players open the studio, cast effects from their own tokens and spawn particles. The GM's client creates the tokens for them.

Animate.Name: Animate particles
Animate.Hint: Particle tokens and auras animate live (swirling, pulsing, flickering). Turn off to show their still images only.

Fps.Name: Particle animation frame rate
Fps.Hint: How many times per second live particle textures are redrawn. Lower it on slow machines.

Emitters.Name: Show particle emitters
Emitters.Hint: Sparks, embers, dust, trails and bursts. Turn off on slow machines.

Info.ClickToPlace: Click on the map to place it, as many times as you like. When you're done, press Escape or pick another tool: the window comes back.
Info.ClickToCast: Click on the map where it should appear. Press Escape or pick another tool when you're done.
Info.DrawWall: Draw the wall's path on the map. Finish a pen path with Enter or a double-click; the effect appears as you draw.
Info.Mold: Click a particle to shape it. Drag its points, pull an edge to make a new corner, or drag inside to move the outline. Double-click a point to make it sharp or round, double-click an edge to add a point, right-click a point to remove it.
Info.Sealed: The seal follows a path: drag its points with the animator's edit tool (double-click the path to add a point, a point to make it a corner). Its look, and whether it blocks movement, are in Effect walls.
Info.ShapeMotion: Shape the path on the map with the animator's tools, then keep it with “Save as template” (or “Update template” for your own) in the animator panel: the effect will use it.
Info.MotionLinked: The effect now moves along “{name}”. Save the effect to keep it.

Warn.SelectTokens: Select one or more tokens first.
Warn.NeedsTarget: This effect flies at targets: target one or more tokens (T) first.
Warn.NeedsCaster: Select the token that casts it first.
Warn.NeedsPoint: Use the Cast tool and click where it should appear.
Warn.NeedsAnimator: This effect moves along an animator template: enable Kostis's Actual Animator.
Warn.CannotModify: Some tokens were skipped because you can't change them.
Warn.WallsNeedAnimator: Effect walls are drawn with Kostis's Actual Animator: enable it first.
Warn.PickPath: Pick a path first (draw one with the animator, or use Draw).
Warn.NoParticleActor: Couldn't set up the shared "Particles" actor that lets particles have owners (check the console).

Error.NoHub: Kostis's Particle Effects needs the Kostis's Flying Paths module. Enable it in Manage Modules.
Error.Mold: Couldn't save the particle's new shape (see the console, F12).
